import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
os.environ['PATH'] = str(Path(sys.executable).parent) + os.pathsep + os.environ.get('PATH', '')
from flashmd import get_pretrained
_, model = get_pretrained('pet-omatpes-v2', 16)
model.save('flashmd-pet-omatpes-v2-16fs.pt')

import os
import urllib.request
from shiftml.utils.loading import load_model
os.makedirs('download', exist_ok=True)
urllib.request.urlretrieve(
    'https://zenodo.org/records/15767390/files/model_1.pt?download=1',
    'download/model.pt',
)
load_model('download/model.pt').save('shiftml3-model-1.pt')
